/-- **The composite-cover span** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): for a span-⊤
family `g : ι → R` with away carriers `S i`, span-⊤ families `h i` on the `S i`, and
numerators `a i l` of the `h i l` (their images associated to the `h i l`), the
products `a i l * g i` span the unit ideal of `R`. Prime avoidance: a prime `M`
missing some `g i` is the trace of a prime `Q` of `S i`
(`PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range`); `Q` misses some `h i l`, hence `M`
misses the numerator `a i l`, hence the product. -/
theorem span_range_num_mul_eq_top {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u} (g : ι → R)
    (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
    [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    {m : ι → ℕ} (h : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → S i)
    (hspan : ∀ i, Ideal.span (Set.range (h i)) = ⊤)
    (a : ∀ i, Fin (m i) → R)
    (hassoc : ∀ i l, Associated (algebraMap R (S i) (a i l)) (h i l)) :
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : Σ i, Fin (m i) => a p.1 p.2 * g p.1) = ⊤ := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal _ hne
  haveI hMprime : M.IsPrime := hMmax.isPrime
  -- some `g i` avoids `M`
  obtain ⟨i, hgi⟩ : ∃ i, g i ∉ M := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    have hM : Ideal.span (Set.range g) ≤ M := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
      rintro - ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hall i)
    rw [hg] at hM
    exact hMmax.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hM)
  -- `M` is the trace of a prime `Q` of `S i`
  have hmem : (⟨M, hMprime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)
      ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (S i))) := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := S i) (g i)]
    exact hgi
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hmem
  have hQM : Q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (S i)) = M :=
    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hQ
  -- some `h i l` avoids `Q`
  obtain ⟨l, hhl⟩ : ∃ l, h i l ∉ Q.asIdeal := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    have hQ' : Ideal.span (Set.range (h i)) ≤ Q.asIdeal := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
      rintro - ⟨l, rfl⟩
      exact hall l)
    rw [hspan i] at hQ'
    exact Q.isPrime.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hQ')
  -- the numerator avoids `M`
  have hal : a i l ∉ M := by
    intro hmem'
    have h1 : algebraMap R (S i) (a i l) ∈ Q.asIdeal :=
      Ideal.mem_comap.mp (hQM.symm ▸ hmem')
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hassoc i l
    exact hhl (hu ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_right (u : S i) Q.asIdeal h1)
  -- primality contradiction on the product
  have hmemM : a i l * g i ∈ M := hle (Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨i, l⟩, rfl⟩)

/-!
# The away-span glue of locally certified classes at CANONICAL carriers

The S5b keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarGlue.lean:71`) glues over an away cover whose carriers `S i`
and overlap carriers `T i j` are supplied *as instance data*.  Every consumer that
starts from a bare spanning family `f : Fin m → S` — which is what the atlas
factorization `divScheme_exists_chartFactor` hands back — must therefore first build
that instance pack itself: eight `Algebra`/`IsScalarTower` fields per index pair, at
`Localization.Away (f p)` and `Localization.Away (f p * f q)`.

This file builds the pack once and states the keystone in the **canonical-carrier**
form, so that a consumer holding only `f` and `Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤` can glue:

* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_awaySpan` — **existence**: locally
  certified classes `F p` over `Localization.Away (f p)`, agreeing after base change to
  each `Localization.Away (f p * f q)`, glue to a class over `S` restricting to every
  `F p`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.eq_of_awaySpan_eq` — **separation** in the same
  spelling: two classes over `S` agreeing at every `Localization.Away (f p)` are equal.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.existsUnique_glue_of_awaySpan` — the two combined, in
  the `∃!` form the forward map's choice bookkeeping consumes.

The overlap carrier is the canonical `Localization.Away (f p * f q)` rather than a
tensor product, which is what makes the pack derivable: it receives both
`Localization.Away (f p)` and `Localization.Away (f q)` by `IsLocalization.Away.lift`
against the divisibility witnesses `f q ∣ f p * f q` and `f p ∣ f p * f q`, and all
tower coherences then reduce to `IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp` and the landed
`isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower`.
-/

`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}

namespace DivFamZar

/-! ## The canonical overlap instance pack -/

section Pack

variable {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)

/-- The canonical overlap carrier receives the `p`-th away carrier: `f p` divides
`f p * f q`, so its image is a unit there and `IsLocalization.Away.lift` produces the
structure map. -/
noncomputable def awayOverlapAlgebraLeft (p q : Fin m) :
    Algebra (Localization.Away (f p)) (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=

divisibility witness `f q ∣ f p * f q`. -/

    (g := algebraMap S (Localization.Away (f p * f q)))
    (IsLocalization.Away.isUnit_of_dvd (x := f p * f q) ⟨f p, mul_comm _ _⟩)).toAlgebra

end Pack

/-! ## Existence -/

/-- **The away-span glue at canonical carriers**: locally certified divisor classes
over the canonical away localizations of a finite spanning family `f`, agreeing after
base change to each canonical overlap localization `Localization.Away (f p * f q)`,
glue to a class over `S` restricting to each of them.

discharged at the canonical carriers: the overlap carrier receives both away carriers
by `IsLocalization.Away.lift` (`awayOverlapAlgebraLeft`/`Right`), the `S`-towers are
`IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp`, and the `k`-towers follow by
`isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower`. -/
theorem exists_glue_of_awaySpan {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (F : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar C (Localization.Away (f p)) π n)
    (hcompat : ∀ p q : Fin m,
      letI := awayOverlapAlgebraLeft f p q
      letI := awayOverlapAlgebraRight f p q
      DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) n (F p)
        = DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) n (F q)) :
    ∃ F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n, ∀ p : Fin m,
      DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p)) n F₀ = F p := by
  classical
  letI algL : ∀ p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f p))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q => awayOverlapAlgebraLeft f p q
  letI algR : ∀ p q : Fin m, Algebra (Localization.Away (f q))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q => awayOverlapAlgebraRight f p q
  haveI towSL : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f p))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
  haveI towSR : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp])
  haveI towkL : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f p))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := S)
  haveI towkR : ∀ p q : Fin m, IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (f q))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) := fun p q =>
    isScalarTower_left_of_isScalarTower (R₀ := S)
  exact DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat f
    (fun p => Localization.Away (f p))
    (fun p q => Localization.Away (f p * f q))
    hspan F hcompat

/-! ## Separation -/

/-- **Separation in the canonical-carrier spelling**: two locally certified classes
over `S` agreeing after base change to every `Localization.Away (f p)` of a finite
spanning family agree — `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq` at the canonical carriers, whose
instance pack is the one already in scope. -/
theorem eq_of_awaySpan_eq {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    {F G : DivFamZar C S π n}
    (h : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p)) n F
      = DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p)) n G) :
    F = G :=
  DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq f (fun p => Localization.Away (f p)) hspan h

/-! ## The `∃!` form -/

/-- **The away-span glue, uniquely**: the glued class of `exists_glue_of_awaySpan` is
the unique class over `S` restricting to the given family, by
`eq_of_awaySpan_eq`.  This is the form the F5 forward map consumes: it makes the glued
value independent of every choice made in producing the cover. -/
theorem existsUnique_glue_of_awaySpan {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → S)
    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (F : ∀ p : Fin m, DivFamZar C (Localization.Away (f p)) π n)
    (hcompat : ∀ p q : Fin m,
      letI := awayOverlapAlgebraLeft f p q
      letI := awayOverlapAlgebraRight f p q
      DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) n (F p)
        = DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) n (F q)) :
    ∃! F₀ : DivFamZar C S π n, ∀ p : Fin m,
      DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (f p)) n F₀ = F p := by
  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
  refine ⟨F₀, hF₀, fun F₁ hF₁ => ?_⟩
  exact eq_of_awaySpan_eq f hspan (fun p => (hF₁ p).trans (hF₀ p).symm)

end DivFamZar

end AlgebraicGeometry

# F5 — gluing the chart pulls of one morphism (`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §3.4)

The affine forward map of DDR-9 is built from three landed pieces:

1. the atlas factorization `divScheme_exists_chartFactor`
   (`Picard/DivSchemeAtlasFactor.lean`) — a morphism `v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver`
   factors, over a finite spanning family `f : Fin m → S`, through carve charts along
   `k`-algebra maps `ω t : R_Z →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (f t)`;
2. the per-chart pull `divRepPullAt` (`Picard/DivRepAffKit.lean`) of a supplied
   universal chart family of `DivFamZar` classes;
3. the overlap agreement `divRepPullAt_mapAlgHom_eq_of_chartFactor`
   (`Picard/DivRepAffChartOverlap.lean`) — two chart presentations of the *same* `v`
   pull to the same class over any common tower ring.

What was missing between them is the glue itself, and the reason is mechanical rather
than mathematical: (3) is stated over an abstract common ring `B` with an instance pack
in scope, while the gluing keystone needs the *canonical* overlap carrier
`Localization.Away (f p * f q)` together with its eight-field pack.
`Picard/DivRepAwaySpanGlue.lean` supplies that pack; this file uses it.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepPullAt_awayMul_compat` — **the overlap hypothesis in the
  canonical spelling**: the chart pulls of the pieces of one factorization agree along
  the two comparison maps into `Localization.Away (f p * f q)`.  This is (3) at the
  canonical carrier, with the comparison maps identified with the structure maps of the
  instance pack.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_divRepPullGlue` — **the glued pull**: the chart pulls glue
  to a class over `S` restricting to each piece.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_divRepPullGlue` — the glued class is the *unique* one
  restricting to the pieces, so it is determined by the factorization data.

Together these are the whole of the `pull` field's construction over a *given*
factorization.  Independence of the choice of factorization is a separate statement,
and it is the one that needs the DDR9-U ε-identity U2 — see the roadmap leaf
`AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.u2`.  Everything in this file is U2-free: it
consumes `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible` as a hypothesis, exactly as
`Picard/DivRepAffChartOverlap.lean` does, and U2 is what will *prove* that hypothesis
for the universal family rather than what is needed to *use* it.
-/

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Grassmannian Scheme

section Curve

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

instance pack is built from the comparison maps themselves, so the abstract

      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    (hU : DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver)

  letI algR : Algebra (Localization.Away (f q)) (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=

      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) (f p * f q) (f p) (f q)

  haveI towSR : IsScalarTower S (Localization.Away (f q))
      (Localization.Away (f p * f q)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (RingHom.ext fun x => by
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
      exact (DivFamZar.awayMulOfDvd_algebraMap (k := k) (f p * f q) (f q) (f p)

      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
